articles.title: Crypto wallet maker Keystone to destroy almost 19,000 devices after security breach
articles.snippet: The breach exposed 25,964 buyer records, some kept past Keystone’s 180-day deletion policy after an automated tool failed without the firm noticing.

articles.title: USDC overtakes USDT in euro stablecoin trading as EU rules reshape market: Kaiko
articles.snippet: USDC’s share of euro stablecoin trading has climbed to 56% since January 2024, with deeper liquidity as exchanges restrict USDT under MiCA.

articles.title: South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029
articles.snippet: The Seoul government is reportedly weighing another delay for a 2020 income tax policy on digital assets, citing concerns with receiving data from US officials.

articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
articles.snippet: Attackers obtained the factory key that proves Keystone's hardware wallets are genuine, and 25,964 buyer records were affected. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved.

articles.title: Bitcoin Mining Firm Luxor Raises $16 Million to Scale Its AI Compute Push
articles.snippet: The CMT Digital-led round, which drew mining-hardware makers Canaan and MicroBT, will fund Luxor’s expansion into AI compute trading, hardware and derivatives.
